subject: Question re; timeline for new releases

messages.author: 05d5691d34ec8949
messages.subject: Question re; timeline for new releases
parts:
Hi,

I have a question for the MRO team: what is the general timeline for new releases of MRO? With R version 3.2.4 released, how long can MRO users expect to wait before MRO catches up with the CRAN version? More broadly, what development steps does the MRO team need to take after a new CRAN version to port (if that is indeed the right term for this type of software development) the CRAN version to the MRO distribution?

Thanks.

messages.author: 149440eddb848db9
messages.subject: Re: Question re; timeline for new releases
parts:
Hi, Sean and Thomas

I don't want to comment precisely on the target release date, since I do not want to disappoint if the schedule slips, for whatever reason.

However, I do hope that we can release an update to R Open within a matter of weeks.

The simplified set of engineering tasks is broadly speaking: include the new version of CRAN R, bundle the Intel MKL, update the build for all of the platforms we support, test and release. 

The release dates are on a schedule together with the other R engineering work we do, e.g. R Server for SQL, Hadoop, HDInsights, etc.

Thank you for your patience and continued interest in Microsoft R Open.

Andrie
